entry.title: New: Resolution 312 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO FULL LIFE TO ASSIST ABLED HAWAI‘I ARTISTS WITH EXPENSES RELATING TO ITS COMMUNITY ART EVENTS FOR INDIVIDUALS WITH DISABILITIES

Transfers $6,900 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 4)

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 312-23 - 10/18/23
